mainEntity.name: Is the Jamie AI note taker free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Jamie's free plan includes 10 AI notes a month, each up to 30 minutes long. Paid plans start at $24 for Plus.

mainEntity.name: How much does Jamie AI cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jamie Plus costs $24, Pro costs $46 a month billed yearly, and Team costs $37 per seat per month billed yearly. Enterprise pricing is custom.

mainEntity.name: Does Jamie join meetings as a bot?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Jamie records audio from your device, so no bot appears in Zoom, Google Meet or Teams. You still need to tell attendees the meeting is being recorded.
Yes, in beta. Jamie offers an iOS app and a beta Android app for in-person meetings. Desktop apps handle online meetings.
Jamie lists notes and transcripts in 99+ languages on its pricing page. Speaker recognition and task detection are included on every plan.

mainEntity.name: What is a good alternative to Jamie?
